data.name: Loop Valley
data.detailed_description:
An alpine valley, and a handful of brushes

Loop Valley is a quiet sandbox for sculpting a storybook alpine bowl — meadows, cliffs, rivers and little settlements that feel lived-in. There is no economy, no combat, and nothing to “win.” You draw, plant, and shape; the valley fills in the rest.

Draw it, and it becomes architecture

  • Trace a ring and raise a castle — curtain walls, towers, gates and wall-walks that step down the hill.
  • Paint a house and the village grows its own lanes, piazzas, lamps and market carts.
  • Run a path across water and get a bridge; up a terrace and get stone stairs.
  • Close a fence on flat meadow and find hay bales waiting; close a dry-stone wall and get a kitchen yard (and a cat on the coping).
  • Put a cottage by the river and a mill wheel turns. Sow flowers by a still pond and dragonflies glitter above the water.
  • String lanterns along a path and night walkers appear after dark.

Nobody places those extras. Closing the loop — or making the right pairing — is the request.

A valley that changes with the light

Sculpt the land, pour water, plant trees, flowers and ivy. Found your own districts. Drag out forts and ruins. Turn the season dial through spring blossom, summer green, autumn gold and winter snow (with frozen ponds). Hold the day, or let dusk settle until the windows come on.

Save your valley

Your work survives a reload — save and load the valleys you care about, tuck the tools away for photo mode, and sit with the diorama whenever you like.

Loop Valley is in Early Access. The valley is playable end-to-end; we’ll keep deepening the gifts, seasons and builder tools with your feedback.

data.short_description: A quiet alpine sandbox. Draw walls, castles, paths and ponds — then watch the valley answer: bridges, mills, hay fields, night walkers, seasons, and lit windows. No scores. No fail state. Just your valley.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with WebGL2 (Intel HD 520 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2 GB VRAM (GTX 1050 / RX 560)
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
